planning_note: This module provides a single, flat group of preprocessor defines and parameters. No instantiable hardware is intended. All configuration options from the spec table are captured as `define` statements; mutually exclusive groups require a build-time selection.

structural_blocks.purpose: Declare all SD‑controller configuration macros (`define`s) listed in the specification.
must_appear: Definitions for every entry in the spec table (BIG_ENDIAN, LITTLE_ENDIAN, SIM, SYN, SDC_IRQ_ENABLE, ACTEL, BD_WIDTH, BD_SIZE, RAM_MEM_WIDTH_16, RAM_MEM_WIDTH, RESEND_MAX_CNT, MEM_OFFSET, RESET_CLK_DIV, SD_CLK_BUS_CLK, SD_CLK_SEP, SD_CLK_STATIC, SD_CLK_DYNAMIC, BLOCK_SIZE, SD_BUS_WIDTH_4, SD_BUS_W, FIFO_RX_MEM_DEPTH, FIFO_RX_MEM_ADR_SIZE, FIFO_TX_MEM_DEPTH, FIFO_TX_MEM_ADR_SIZE).
Clear comment guidance for exclusive options (e.g., only one of BIG_ENDIAN/LITTLE_ENDIAN, SIM/SYN, SD_CLK_* group).
may_appear: Internal helper defines strictly derived from the above (e.g., log2 derivations, one‑hot selector for exclusive groups).
retrieval_focus: values of BD_SIZE, FIFO depths, clock mode, endianness (compile‑time constants used by all other SD modules)

semantic_modes.meaning: A single set of active defines is selected before synthesis/simulation; no run‑time mode switching.

global_invariants: All non‑selected mutually exclusive options must be left undefined or explicitly deactivated according to the spec.
Output is a fixed set of global macros visible to all later-compiled modules.
open_semantic_questions: Whether default values exist for optional defines (e.g., SDC_IRQ_ENABLE absent) is unspecified; the skeleton must allow optional presence.

responsibilities: Provide every configuration macro needed by other SD controller modules.
Document the valid domain and mutual exclusion rules for each group.
touched_objects: none (no hardware objects, only textual substitution tokens)
coupling_rules: Other modules `include` this file and rely on the macro names exactly as defined.
Changes to macro names or value domains require synchronized updates across all dependent modules.
forbidden_drift: Do not instantiate hardware (no `reg`, `wire`, `module`, or sequential logic).
Do not add run‑time configuration registers or dynamic redefinition logic not mentioned in the spec.

chosen_decisions.decision: All defines reside in a single declaration block; no sub‑blocking is required because there is no control flow or data dependency among them.
chosen_decisions.reason: The module is a flat set of compile‑time constants; splitting would add artificial hierarchy not present in the spec.

deferred_decisions: Exact mapping of decimal/hex values for derived parameters (e.g., log2‑based ADR_SIZE) is deferred to code generation.
Which mutually exclusive group member becomes the “active” definition is a build‑system choice, not a skeleton choice.
structural_risks: If the file grows with additional non‑standard defines not in the spec, auto‑retrieval may mix project‑specific additions with spec‑driven definitions.
behavioral_risks: Omitting a required define or mismatching a mutually exclusive group may cause downstream modules to mis‑interpret bus widths, clock sources, or buffer sizes; the skeleton cannot validate compile‑time completeness.
